effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Task-boundary shared attack-memory DER++ adaptation: current and retained-old attack balanced CE, stored raw-logit MSE only over seen-at-admission outputs, independent old-memory replay CE. DUAL applies the latter two losses only to the stable contribution of the joint head; no plastic-branch distillation. Not online-reservoir DER++. No task-growing branches.
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: Registered fixed original AR; no tuning
effective_config.selection_validation_policy: Retained old-class validation only; no selection

score_definition: max_attack((attack_logit-Normal_logit)/(float32_prior_Normal-float32_prior_attack)); descriptive real-arithmetic crossing tau. Original predictions retain torch float32 prior shift.

original_holdout_calibration.prior_role: Original prepared TRAIN labels before permanent holdout or smoke subset; no TEST role

protocol.finite_sample_limit: FP <= floor(alpha * calibration_count); strict Normal prior maximum and nonincreasing observed FP required
protocol.limitation: The permanent pool was available to allocation validation; it is not a fresh independent calibration sample
protocol.pool: Same seed-specific permanent Normal TRAIN holdout for every method; never optimized
protocol.replay_la: Same Replay weights and total tau; baseline tau=1 plus delta, no extra training or inference
protocol.rule: First adjacent initial-grid bracket when present; otherwise expand toward the missing infeasible lower or feasible upper endpoint; retain feasible upper endpoint after 50 bisections
protocol.test_role: Evaluate selected total tau only; test metrics never select tau or the expansion range

scope: Read-only score-transfer association and per-class geometry description; no training/calibration changes or feature-causal explanation. Large seed BAcc spread with near1% TEST FPR does not establish numerical bisection failure.

publication.change_scope: Personal-path/account redaction and this metadata only; scientific numbers unchanged. CM/holdout-FP exactness is not original-logit bitexactness.
